- memory_id "1000101": As of 2025-01-14, Oskar takes the first Ember team on-call shift of the year.  (about: Ember team, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000304": As of 2025-04-03, Tomasz should be paged for anything this cycle and is back on the Atlas team on-call rotation.  (about: Atlas team, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000331": In the catalog service, joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time.  (about: product catalog, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000263": As of 2025-03-17, Lena has the Boreal pager, taking over from Marcus.  (about: Boreal team, Lena)
